answer: Nonce-Binding Answer Protocol. Each agent must answer a fresh, unpredictable challenge whose correct response depends on a private key plus live local entropy; the resulting signal is verifiable but never reusable. Answers are checked against a rolling pulse of challenge hashes, so replaying an old reply fails immediately. A fable circulating among clones collapses because copies emit identical nonces. To sustain N identities, an attacker must run N distinct real-time computations, paying full per-identity compute and latency cost with no amortization.
